name: AGENT_OUTCOME_LINKER_BACKLOG_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: AGENT_OUTCOME_LINKER_BACKLOG_20261107 — agent-outcome-linker stopped at its first page every run
(1000 proposals + 500 trades) and reported ok, while 1,086,356 unlinked (recommendation, proposal) pairs —
663,920 of them from July alone — sat behind it. The receipt said ok and nothing in it said the queue was
more than a thousand runs long.
The gate pins the new contract in scripts/agent_outcome_linker.py: an --apply run pages until both SELECTs
come back short (drained) or its budget is spent (--max-links / --max-seconds, default 20000 links / 100 s
inside the executor's 180 s kill), the receipt records drained, budget_exhausted, pages, the budget and
backlog_recommendations, a dry run reads exactly one page and never writes, and an unreadable backlog count
Hermetic: fake connections record every statement; no database, no network.
